description: What ui/tests/api.test.mjs must notice of the page's side of P9 ac-10: the reason of a denial and the extras of a plan answer reach the Hub (decidePermission, denyAction, and the deny handler of ConversationView, which used to drop the reason), the plan decision names the revision the page showed, an edit of the plan sends its baseRevision, and nothing is sent that the caller did not give; and of ac-11: planMode goes with a start or a continue only when it was chosen.

mutations.name: U1
mutations.what: decidePermission drops the feedback, the edited plan and the execution

mutations.name: U2
mutations.what: denyAction drops the reason of the denial

mutations.name: U3
mutations.what: decidePlan does not name the revision the page showed

mutations.name: U5
mutations.what: an optional field the caller did not give is sent as null

mutations.name: U6
mutations.what: the conversation screen drops the reason of a denial again

mutations.name: U7
mutations.what: a conversation started in plan mode starts without it (P9 ac-11)

mutations.name: U8
mutations.what: a conversation continued in plan mode continues without it (P9 ac-11)

mutations.name: U9
mutations.what: planMode: false is sent, which asks the Hub to leave plan mode (P9 ac-11)

mutations.name: U10
mutations.what: a new conversation sends planMode: false (P9 ac-11)
